changelog: Deploy the trained LoRA adapter from CI instead of Kaggle. A green Kaggle run still ended with the old adapter live, because Kaggle's UserSecrets service is not reliable inside a pushed batch kernel and returned "Connection error trying to communicate with service" even with the secrets attached. The workflow now waits for the kernel, downloads the adapter it produced, and uploads it to Cloudflare Workers AI with the repository secrets, failing the job when the adapter is missing or the upload fails - so a run can no longer report success without deploying. The runner gained a --deploy-only mode for that path. Previous release: gave every Kaggle training row the same shape.
